visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with multiple extreme close-up shots of golden-brown fried chicken wings and drumettes packed inside white paper bags. The chicken's skin appears exceptionally crispy with a bumpy, breaded texture. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the oily sheen and savory color of the meat. (2) A hand with clean, short nails enters the frame, picking up a single drumette to showcase its size and texture against the white paper background. (3) A hand is seen holding a smartphone displaying a call in progress. The screen shows a local phone number 0927-862-778 and a call timer. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor food stall where a female worker with her hair tied back, wearing a black t-shirt, brown apron, and a white face mask, is busily packing fried chicken into bags. A male customer in a red shirt and a female customer in a blue cap are visible at the counter. (5) Further close-ups of the chicken pieces are shown, focusing on the juicy interior as the narrator handles the food. (6) The final sequence shows the stall's menu board with prices listed as $60, $100, $120, and $150, followed by a wide shot of the stall named '錡機家族豆乳雞' located on a city street. Two women, one in a pink helmet and one in a white dress, stand near the stall.
